title: Marvell grants Google warrant to buy up to $12.2 billion in shares in AI chip deal
reason: Published same-day: flagged as a strong candidate in cycle 3's report and picked up first this cycle. Fresh verifier and fresh adversarial-falsifier sub-agents run in parallel, neither having drafted the story. The verifier located Marvell's actual Form 8-K on SEC EDGAR (read via a filings mirror after sec.gov 403'd the fetch tool) and found the deal's real substance differs from the raw leads' generic 'AI chip deal' framing: it covers silicon attached to Google's AI infrastructure (inference accelerators, storage/network/memory-interface controllers, near-memory compute), not Google's TPU chip itself, which remains primarily Broadcom's. The falsifier found no denial or dispute, confirmed the deal is a genuine new disclosure (not a rehash of an unconfirmed April 2026 talks report), and flagged the Marvell stock-move percentage as inconsistent across outlets (7-14% depending on source/time) -- written into the article as a range rather than one asserted figure. No open obligation: the transaction (warrant grant, underlying commercial agreement) is already executed and disclosed, not a pending outcome; multi-year vesting through FY2033 depends on Google's future purchases but is not a near-term follow-up item in the sense of an unshipped product or unresolved case.
